scope: entire nonsymmetric rank2 negative-top type, all positive top and all Jordan types
fourth_power_obstruction: uU=F(U)u, F2=-i*I, uv=a(U),vu=b(U),F(b)=a,F(a)=-b imply u2*v=-v*u2 and u4 anticommutes with U, commutes with V. A normal positive cubic both commutes and anticommutes with u4, hence is zero in a domain.
singular_r_plus_minus_one: r=-1 equivalent to r=1; rank2-cross normalized A=(a,a,0,b,c,c), six-Pfaffian ideal=(a2,ac,b,c2), hence A=0 on geometric points, contradicting projection rank3
conclusion: no H3 with this nonsymmetric negative top; only symmetric secant remains when P,Q are both nonzero
